items.headline: 2027 Budget faces Second Reading vote as executive officers strike
items.summary: Parliament votes on the 2027 Budget's Second Reading at 6 PM today after a seven-day debate. Officers from 20 government executive services held a one-day islandwide strike, saying the Budget widens pay gaps.

items.headline: CBSL Governor warns inflation could near 9% by December
items.summary: The Central Bank Governor said inflation may climb to around 9% and stay elevated for months, citing the Middle East conflict and high fuel prices.

items.headline: GMOA threatens trade union action
items.summary: The Government Medical Officers' Association says its letters seeking talks with the President, PM and Health Minister went unanswered, and warned of trade union action.

items.headline: 'Rotumba Amila' returned from Russia
items.summary: An alleged underworld and drug-trafficking figure wanted over organised crime was brought back to Sri Lanka from Russia.

items.headline: Sri Lanka passes 2 million tourists for third year running
items.summary: The country welcomed its two-millionth tourist of 2026, the third consecutive year the milestone has been reached.

items.headline: Imran Khan release motion rejected
items.summary: An opposition MP's adjournment motion urging the release of Pakistan's former PM was blocked, with Pakistan ties cited.

items.headline: New Immigration Bill cleared by committee
items.summary: A parliamentary oversight committee approved the new Immigration Bill.

items.headline: Thai Deputy PM visit to bring visa exemption deal
items.summary: Sri Lanka and Thailand are set to sign a visa exemption agreement during the Thai Deputy Prime Minister's visit.

items.headline: Committee concerned over domestic gas price hikes
items.summary: A parliamentary committee raised concerns about recent increases in household LP gas prices.

items.headline: Rupee steady against US dollar
items.summary: Central Bank rates showed the rupee broadly unchanged against the dollar.

items.headline: Seven new airlines in two years
items.summary: Seven new international carriers have started flying to Sri Lanka over the past two years.

items.headline: Korea-backed ocean data centre launched
items.summary: A new ocean data centre supported by South Korea aims to improve fishing forecasts.

items.headline: Namal Rajapaksa remanded until Dec 1 in Krrish case
items.summary: Namal Rajapaksa and a former Krrish director were further remanded, and the court ordered an investigation report by December 1.

items.headline: Bail denied to Chamara Sampath
items.summary: A Colombo court refused bail to Chamara Sampath Dassanayake in a Rs. 8.4 million bribery case.

items.headline: Dozens of Maskeliya students hospitalised
items.summary: Around 36 students from a Maskeliya school were hospitalised with breathing difficulties; Newsfirst reports suspected food poisoning.

items.headline: Two sentenced to death over 2013 Hikkaduwa killing
items.summary: A High Court convicted two men of a killing linked to a personal dispute and sentenced them to death.

items.headline: Afternoon thundershowers forecast
items.summary: Afternoon thundershowers are expected across much of the island over the next few days.

items.headline: CEA health advisory on poor air quality
items.summary: Air quality has worsened in several areas, and the Central Environmental Authority issued a health advisory.

items.headline: Police target dengue breeding sites
items.summary: Police are acting against mosquito breeding grounds and illegal waste dumping as the rains raise dengue risk.

items.headline: Pakistan beat Sri Lanka to win Test series 1-0
items.summary: Pakistan won the second Test in Rawalpindi by eight wickets, extending Sri Lanka's run to eight series without a win.

items.headline: Mahela Jayawardene joins Delhi Capitals
items.summary: The former Sri Lanka captain was appointed Delhi Capitals' director of cricket.

items.headline: Poland says Russian missile hit its territory
items.summary: Poland says at least one Russian missile struck its southeast during an overnight attack on Ukraine; no injuries were reported.

items.headline: ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
items.summary: The International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya.

items.headline: FBI team concludes Sri Lanka visit on scam probe
items.summary: FBI and US Justice Department officials wrapped up a week-long visit linked to a scam investigation.
